title: GA4GH IO Profile Parameter Keywords
description: Keywords that bind a parameter of an IO schema (a property of inputs or outputs) to the parameter of the engine, where their names or types differ.

x-ga4gh-parameter.description: The engine's parameter for this property of inputs or outputs.

name.description: The name of the parameter in the engine, relative to the entry point (e.g., align.threads for an input of the WDL call align); defaults to the name of the property.

type.description: The type of the parameter as declared in the workflow language (e.g., Array[File]+ or Pair[Int,String] in WDL, File[]? in CWL), for translators and converters that need more than the JSON Schema type.
